title: I'm a ninja
wikitext:
Quote by the Norwegian [[Sectopod]], under a Quake-match against [[Sujoy]] on [[DM4]] at the  True Gamers Invitational [[1999]]. Sectopod awaited in the megaroom  too hear  Sujoy, and fired a rocket straight into the wall to gain a boost - he  bunnyhopped around the corner and past him in terrible speed

* Sujoy:

"gad damn that was fast"

* Sectopod:

"yea"
"i'm a ninja"

About sectopods achivements under the tournament: http://www.challenge-au.com/events/tgi/page9.html
